description: GCompris is open showing the Science/Experiment category (Experiment tab). Find and click the 'Mixing paint colors' activity tile (shows a paint palette with colorful blobs). In this activity, a target color is displayed at the top ('Match the color' with a colored rectangle showing the goal). Three paint tubes (magenta, cyan, and yellow) are shown with + and - buttons. Click the + and - buttons on each paint tube to adjust how much of each color to add, mixing them together in the white ball in the center. When the mixed color matches the target color, click the green OK button to confirm. Complete at least one color-matching exercise successfully.
